result.title: Learning Clean Generative Processes from Noisy Measurements
result.summary: We study how to learn a generative model of clean images using only noisy observations. Diffusion processes and their generalizations to non-Gaussian noise require posterior predictions at every noise level. We first show that it is possible to learn these predictions from independent noisy views using Noise2Noise regression, but only at or above the noise level of the training data. To learn the predictions below that level, needed to generate clean images, we impose consistency: a prediction should equal its expectation after continuing the sampling process. We derive conditions under which consistency uniquely determines the continuation to the clean image distribution and verify them for Poisson, binomial, Gamma, and negative-binomial measurements. Experiments on CIFAR-10, photon-counting microscopy, and synthetic aperture radar show that the required posterior predictions can be learned from noisy views alone and that the consistency relation repairs the continuation beyond the noise level of the data, which severely deteriorates without consistency.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究如何在仅有噪声观测的情况下学习干净图像的生成模型：先在训练噪声水平之上用 Noise2Noise 回归学后验预测，再以「采样延续后预测应等于其期望」的一致性约束补足更低噪声水平的预测，并在 CIFAR-10、光子计数显微与 SAR 数据上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于噪声测量下的扩散式图像生成，关注的是去噪后验预测与采样延续，不涉及视觉推理状态、证据获取或停止决策；其中的一致性关系与 latent 轨迹监督的类比过于宽泛，缺乏可核查的具体方法线索。
